2893-3875-7906-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Thranduil's Company trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Thranduil's Company trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

116-1557-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kiora's Follower is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
116-1557-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
116-1557-4613.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.

728-2577-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
728-2577-5478-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
728-2577-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1844-4247-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least X.
1844-4247-5571--6.description:
Use Fateful Handoff to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 2.

277-3129-4094-4772-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-3129-4094-4772-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

553-4586-4838.description:
During the opponent's end step immediately before your turn, cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W} using Najal.
In response, cast Endless Detour by paying its mana cost, putting Approach of the Sun on top of your library.
In your draw step, draw Approach of the Second Sun.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying {6}{W}, winning the game.

372-1090-1567.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-1090-1567.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Momentary Blink by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

412-3081-3817-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2724-3080-4608-7715.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-7715.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

2558-4659-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-4659-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

444-2894-3595-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-2894-3595-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Shambling Shell. Then, the draw will be replaced by Shambling Shell's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Shambling Shell from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-3209-4249-5094.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 7.
2757-3209-4249-5094.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-7010.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
3532-3949-5078-7010.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6199-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

856-1379-5686-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2060-4518-6930.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Birgi and Spider-Man India trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

631-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Grim Haruspex.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Phyrexian Marauder from your library.
Repeat.

2173-5220-5686-6537.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
Repeat.

511-560-817-1887-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldier and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2510-3054-4050.easyPrerequisites:
You have gained life this turn.
There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-3054-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1339-2099-2558-6666.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-2099-2558-6666.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Insect.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat from step 2.

2342-2512-6562.description:
Cast Daru Spiritualist by paying {1}{W}.
When Daru Spiritualist enters the battlefield, Jaws of Defeat triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, giving it +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Shaman en-Kor ability.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing an opponent to lose an arbitrarily large amount of life.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-1283-6260.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-1283-6260.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

643-1486-1753-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.
643-1486-1753-5475.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1429-3967-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-3967-4875-5402.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

710-2730-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha, adding {R}.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

372-2493-5530.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Another Round exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Another Round.
372-2493-5530.description:
Cast Another Round by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Another Round from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Another Round.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2061-2104-2239.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation each turn.
2061-2104-2239.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2102-3814-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional land.
2102-3814-5929.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Griffin Canyon and another land.
Activate Griffin Canyon's second ability by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1594-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

129-4474-5137.description:
Activate Morphling by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Morphling by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
129-4474-5137.notes: Once you have infinite {U}, you can instead tap for other colors of mana. Notably, you can tap for {G} to use Kinnan's ability.

1953-2959-3057.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1953-2959-3057.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Bloodthirster.
Move to your combat phase.
Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all creature tokens you control to become a copy of the Bloodthirster token.
Deal combat damage with any Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

50-2060-3539-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Minister of Impediments does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Minister of Impediments.
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
50-2060-3539-4222.description:
Activate Minister of Impediments by tapping it, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Solitary Sactuary triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Minister of Impediments.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

1309-2080-4050.notablePrerequisites: The number of nontoken creatures you control plus the number of creature cards in all graveyards is at least nine.
1309-2080-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, adding {B}.
Repeat step 1 for each other nontoken creature you control.
Cast Rise of the Dark Realms by paying {7}{B}{B}, returning all creature cards from all graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rise of the Dark Realms to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

500-2047-3129-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-2047-3129-4772.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

500-864-914.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
500-864-914.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Dockside Extortionist and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Both Dockside Extortionist tokens enter the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate nine Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}{G}{G}.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Eternal Witness and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Both Eternal Witness tokens enter the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
